title: THE FREQUENCY BENEATH · The flats, as a trace
venue: private · after a paperback found in the library's return cart · Box 26
logline: The flats at low tide drawn as an oscilloscope trace across graph paper: the tide line a slow wave, the channels sharp drops, the pup's prints a train of blips, and under all of it a second trace, steady, the same height everywhere. The book's frequency. The page measures the mud.

panels.composition: Graph paper filling the page; across it a hand-drawn trace: a slow wave for the tide line, sharp drops for channels, a train of small blips labelled by shape as a dog's prints; beneath, a second flat steady trace running edge to edge.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a page of graph paper with a hand-drawn oscilloscope trace across it, a slow wave with sharp drops and a train of small blips, and a second flat steady trace running beneath it edge to edge, no words legible
image.notes: The steady trace: the substrate (Vol 7). Never named. The blips are the pup.

art.line: the private line, but ruled: graph paper, waveforms, spectrogram bands drawn by hand
art.palette: ochre and slate; the trace in one warm color
